notes.title: Ship Graveyard Simulator 2 | CO-OP Mode Playtest Are Open!
notes.content:
[h2]We are very pleased to announce that the CO-OP Mode Playtest has just started and are open to everyone! 💥[/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2201940/Ship_Graveyard_Simulator_2/

[h2]👇 [u][b]IMPORTANT[/b][/u] 👇[/h2]
[h3][b]Please remember that these are Playtest of the upcoming version of CO-OP Mode - [u]it is not the final version[/u] - therefore, there may be some gameplay issues and bugs.[/b] [/h3]

If you encounter any bugs or something else, please let us know on Community Hub or our Discord, it will help us to improve the final version of CO-OP - thank you. 


[h3][b]🔶 For players who have signed up earlier[/b] - you can start playing the CO-OP Playtest now.[/h3]

[h3][b]🔶 For players who did not sign up before the start[/b] - first click the "request access" button and then you will automatically get access to the Playtest.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43183323/cece9ff7091de99b50c645877192263955ede73b.jpg[/img]

[h3][b][u]Playtest of the CO-OP Mode[/u][/b][/h3]
We decided to Playtest the upcoming CO-OP Mode because we plan to release it for the game in the upcoming 2024 and would like to hear the opinion of our community before we add it to the game. Playtest is something like beta testing, so you can feel like a real QA Tester!

[h3][b]General information[/b][/h3]
The game will have some restrictions against the full version of the game. Read carefully what you can expect! 
[list][*] The server has been limited to 3 players
[*] Available ships are[b] Maroon Lagoon[/b] (connector HP has been reduced) and [b]Caroline[/b]
[*] Players will get more money to start so they can buy both ships plus additional tool upgrades.
[*] For the duration of the playtests, the following will disappear from the game: [/list]- Winche
- Hazard
- Crouching
- Crane upgrades
- Mobile cargo along with input for walkie talkies
- Collectibles 
- Load option
- Continue option
- Credits

[h3][b]Warning:[/b][/h3]
[b]A new player cannot join the game while a ship is ordered! All players must be present before buying a ship[/b]



[h3][b][u]Suggestions and feedback[/u][/b][/h3]
We encourage you to send your feedback, suggestions, and bugs you may encounter. We will be very pleased if you leave your opinion about the upcoming CO-OP Mode, it is very important to us to listen to the opinions of our community. You can do this by:

[b]1. Steam Community Hub[/b], where we have created appropriate topics. We also encourage you to create your own.
[list][*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2201940/discussions/0/4036978063918499529/]📖 CO-OP PLAYTEST | SUGGESTIONS & FEEDBACK[/url]
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2201940/discussions/0/4036978063918499655/]🐛 CO-OP PLAYTEST | BUGS & PROBLEMS[/url][/list][b]2. On our dedicated Discord[/b] - https://discord.gg/evKuacn8uE


[b]3. Directly in the Ship Graveyard Simulator 2 Playtest[/b] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2567570/]Steam page[/url]


[h2][b]We can't wait to hear your first impressions! 😊[/b][/h2]

[url=https://discord.gg/evKuacn8uE][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43183323/25cdf2608fb8ca229fa863444a8fbfb772c1e50f.png[/img][/url]

Have fun!
SGS2 Team

notes.title: UPCOMING UPDATES
notes.content:
[h2][b]Hello Fans! [/b]🛳️[/h2]

It's been almost two weeks since the premiere of Ship Graveyard Simulator, and we thank you very much for your commitment and Steam reviews as well as participating in the discussion on discord and the Steam community hub. From the very beginning of production, we informed you about the progress of the game development and listened to your suggestions, and it is no different after the game's release.

⚓ After analyzing your feedback about the game being too short, having too much money, and progressing through the game too fast we decided to prepare a game-changing balance update for you. Also, we don’t want to make the game too hard for those who are enjoying the current game balance so we decided to create game difficulties: Normal and Easy. The current balance will be easy mode and new changes normal mode.

⚓ We decreased most of the material prices. instead, we increased tools and ship costs and changed hammer damage. Moreover, we improved the process of materials gathering thanks to the burner. We also decided to raise the effectiveness of workers you can hire. Now they will provide more materials. We are aware that orders were the biggest problem, therefore we decreased the amount of experience and gold they give.

⚓ Moreover, we prepared a new game mechanic for you - the destruction progress bar. Now you can see the percentage of damage on the currently booked ship so you can see how much there is left to destroy.

⚓ The most important suggestion and comment that appeared most often is the possibility of complete ship disassembly, we are analyzing such options, but since we designed the game for limited disassembly, it would require a complete redesign of ship models and implementation of new mechanics. Nevertheless, we are analyzing this possibility, but first of all, we are focusing on improving the current version of the game.

⚓ Finally, we prepared new achievements connected with destroying every ship in the game.

[h3][b]Please write to us what you think about the upcoming changes and we encourage you to join our Discord channel![/b][/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1286880/Ship_Graveyard_Simulator/

[url=https://discord.gg/cHCTwwvan9][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37395483/3275740acc70c627275e89ee73f2cec9575f4e27.png[/img][/url]

Regards,
Ship Graveyard Simulator Team

notes.title: Devlog #19 Ordering Ships
notes.content:
[h2]Welcome to another Ship Graveyard Simulator devlog! [/h2]

What would the Ship Graveyard be without the ships? They can be a huge source of materials, but of course, they are not endless themselves. What to do when you take them apart fully and you still need more and more materials? Today we will present something, that we are very proud of - [b]the ordering ships[/b] feature. 🛒

In earlier devlogs, we mentioned that in your cosy, little house you will find a computer which can be used for some cool features. Today is the day! We can finally present it! Hurray!  

After turning on the computer, the first thing that will pop up is [b]ShipTube[/b]. It's a website where you can order as many ships as you need! The first thing you will see on the left of the screen, are active orders. If you ordered something recently, you will find it there. On the right side of the screen, you can see your balance (all the money you've earned) and available ships. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37395483/5897fb275eb8fad66fa7c2520aaf54ae3487f247.png[/img]

Let's get straight into that! After choosing that option you will see more details of a certain ship. You will see the size of it, how much you will have to pay (per day), how much does the ship weight and more. But the most important information you will see here are [b]predicted materials[/b]. By studing this part carefully you can decide if this certain ship is all you need, or maybe you would like to choose a different one. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37395483/e48ffc7046b818544f9066e491cc35f0e769da25.png[/img]

If you are fully decided on a ship, you need to click the "book" button. Then you will see a message informing that the booking is completed and you will see the information about the exact time and place where your ship will arrive. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37395483/9d9014960d4a272b0bf55de8f3509b25f708ea07.png[/img]

notes.title: Devlog #16 - Skills and levels
notes.content:
[h2]Welcome to another Ship Graveyard Simulator devlog! [/h2]

As you may already noticed in the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1286880/Ship_Graveyard_Simulator/][b]DEMO[/b][/url], we decided to introduce the [b]leveling system[/b] of our character. The more we do in the game, the more experience we get. The key feature in this system are skill points, which we can use to buy perks in the special menu. 

By looking at the picture you can already tell that you will have an option to improve the tool's statistics, but also to buy more personal perks like movement speed or car slots. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37395483/2c00d7665d0490dafaf68dc722f7e9ec45a7a3fc.png[/img]

Leveling up hammers, saws and other tools is also a key feautre in Ship Graveyard Simulator, because it means more cool buffs such as speed, sharpness and damage of a certain tool. 

What do you think about this feature? Do you have your own ideas for perks? Let's talk in the comments! 

[url=https://discord.gg/cHCTwwvan9][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37395483/3275740acc70c627275e89ee73f2cec9575f4e27.png[/img][/url]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1286880/Ship_Graveyard_Simulator/

notes.title: Devlog #15 - Lockpicking
notes.content:
[h2]Welcome to another Ship Graveyard Simulator devlog! [/h2]

Have you heard about the Ship Graveyard Simulator demo? If not, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1286880/Ship_Graveyard_Simulator/][b]play now[/b][/url]!

Do you like finding collectibles while playing your favourite games? Because we cannot imagine Ship Graveyard Simulator without that! You may have already noticed that there are some cool-looking chests that can be found all around the ships. Unfortunately, they are always locked... 🔒 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37395483/073e39c15c0244ec648b4c9f52783aa3f811abb7.png[/img]

The solution has never been easier! We can buy lockpics in our local shops. After interacting with this tool, we will unlock another feature in the game - [b]lockpicking[/b]. Now we need some time and patience 😊 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37395483/a13046ee93a497ae2aafdfb5cf50b47df327f847.png[/img]

After all, the effort is worth the prize, isn't it? 😊 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37395483/b6ba9fa3ca5961553082980539fac21d36b00ebd.png[/img]

Ready for more? Stay tuned for another devlog!
